_meta.purpose: The engine-alone MISSES from validation_run_modern_30.md — moderate/high-institution states that ruptured anyway. T3 is run on them as a CONSISTENCY CHECK: does the exposure layer DISCRIMINATE — flag the relational (exogenous-military) misses HIGH and correctly stay LOW on the internal-channel misses?
_meta.discipline: CONSISTENCY CHECK, NOT VALIDATION. These cases motivated/shaped T3; re-scoring them shows the mechanism behaves as intended, it cannot validate it. Firewalled from any out-of-sample claim and from the 213/77/0 baseline.
_meta.internal_read: P1 = V-Dem rule-of-law at the pre-shock year (vdem_longrun.json), the same proxy used in the 30-run. Citable-tier for the exposure layer (COW CINC, >=1816).

Greece@1919.label: Greece, Asia Minor campaign 1919-1922 (engine-alone MISS — EXOGENOUS-military)

engine_alone.miss_type: exogenous-military: defeat in Anatolia, not internal collapse

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW CINC c.1920; Greece overextended deep in Anatolia vs a resurgent adversary on its own ground

E2_patron.detail: Initial British (Lloyd George) backing collapsed by 1921-22 as France and Italy tilted to Kemal and the Allies withdrew support. No credible defender at the crisis.

E3_contested_border.detail: Mutually contested Anatolia/Smyrna (Megali Idea vs Turkish national movement).

E5_great_power_faultline.detail: Post-Ottoman partition contested by the great powers.

R4_strategic_depth.provenance: Greece area; note the FORCES were overextended far from home depth in Anatolia

Greece@1919.outcome_factual: Catastrophic defeat in Anatolia (1922); Smyrna burned; population exchange; the 1922 revolution at home.

Spain@1936.label: Spain 1936 (engine-alone MISS — INTERNAL polarization, NOT relational)

engine_alone.miss_type: endogenous: civil war from internal left-right polarization

E1_relative_power.detail: No external state sought to conquer Spain. Foreign involvement (German/Italian aid to Franco, Soviet to the Republic) came IN SUPPORT OF FACTIONS, not as a conquest of Spanish sovereignty — that is not relational EXPOSURE.

E3_contested_border.detail: No external state held a territorial claim against Spain in 1936.

E4_neighborhood.detail: Western Europe was at peace in 1936 (pre-WWII); no neighbor war spilling in.

E5_great_power_faultline.detail: Spain was peripheral; the war BECAME an ideological proxy, but the proximate shock was the internal July-1936 coup.

Spain@1936.outcome_factual: Spanish Civil War 1936-39; Franco dictatorship to 1975.
Spain@1936.t3_expectation: T3 SHOULD read LOW structural exposure — Spain 1936 is an INTERNAL-channel miss. If T3 flags it high, T3 is over-claiming; if low, T3 correctly DOES NOT resolve it, pointing to a different missing layer (acute internal polarization).

Portugal@1926.label: Portugal 1926 (engine-alone MISS — INTERNAL military coup)

E1_relative_power.detail: No external state threatening Portuguese sovereignty in 1926.

Portugal@1926.outcome_factual: 28 May 1926 coup -> the Estado Novo dictatorship (to 1974).
Portugal@1926.t3_expectation: LOW exposure expected — internal-channel miss; T3 should not resolve it.
